name: Sculpfun S10 10W
tagline: 2025 Sculpfun S10 line : industrial-style frame, 385 mm bed
tldr: Sculpfun S10 10W launched in 2025 as a mid-size open-frame engraver with a sturdier industrial frame than S9, ~385 mm work area, and detachable laser cover. Positioned between budget S9 and S30 families for makers who want better rigidity without Ultra pricing.
mainObjective: Mid-tier Sculpfun engraving with a stiffer frame than S9

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: 10W on Sculpfun S10: engraving-first : photo fills and leather at moderate speeds
Open-frame : plan laser glasses, exhaust, and workspace rules from day one
Software on the profile : trial your workflow on scrap before production
cons: Clear cast acrylic and thick production cutting still favor CO₂, not diode power alone
Confirm optical wattage on the listing before you buy
beginnerNotes: This profile covers Sculpfun S10 10W. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks before buying, then compare nearby models on the Compare page.
proTips: Pair with 30L/min air assist per Sculpfun spec for cleaner cuts.
primaryUse: 2025 Sculpfun mid-size engraver for detailed work and light cutting on a reinforced frame.

editorialDepth.advantages: Sculpfun S10 10W suits makers who sell marks, photos, and gifts more than daily panel cutting. Reasonable open-frame entry price.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if you already quote 3 mm+ cutting in production. Not for cast acrylic or bare metal without spray.
